title: GitHub Developer, Stargazer & Contributor Lead Enricher Input

repositories.title: Target GitHub Repositories (owner/repo)
repositories.description: List of GitHub repositories (e.g. ['apify/crawlee', 'langchain-ai/langchain']) to extract top contributors from.

usernames.title: Direct GitHub Usernames (Optional)
usernames.description: Optional list of specific GitHub usernames to enrich directly.

maxDevelopersPerRepo.title: Max Developers Per Repository
maxDevelopersPerRepo.description: Maximum number of contributors to enrich per repository.

githubToken.title: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token (For Higher Rate Limits)
githubToken.description: Optional GitHub token to raise API rate limits from 60 req/hr to 5,000 req/hr.
